subject: You came to visit!
body:
You made it to the lab!! Welcome back! It's been too long.

I've set up some trades for you. I'll take corndogs for duct tape, any time, no questions asked. I've also got a few valuable things I've found around Elythia I know you'll be interested in. An easter bunny you may remember from long ago.

Your old friend,
Dr. T
